design_note: Single Next.js 16 app (App Router, RSC) + Prisma/SQLite + @anthropic-ai/sdk (already installed). Design the target architecture for the SkillSync MVP: data model (Employee/Profile, Skill with trust-state machine self-reported->manager-approved->cert-verified, current project + allocation% + freeFrom, CatalogItem with aiEnabled/endorsed/tags/enrichment, UpskillingPlan, Certificate + Resume upload refs, OAuth-identity->synthetic-profile mapping table), API/route design (route handlers/server actions), the Claude integration layer (prompts in src/prompts/, Zod schemas, model routing Sonnet/Opus, prompt caching of profile dataset), auth (Google OAuth restricted to nulogic.io), and the hero loop. Keep it demo-pragmatic, NOT over-engineered. Strategic ADRs for the key choices (auth lib, persistence, Claude call patterns, file/upload handling, validation).
